name: paprika3d
description: Three.js MCP server and Claude Code plugin: screenshot, play, test and profile the three.js, React Three Fiber and WebGL pages your coding agent builds. paprika3d is the toolset that makes your coding agent a better three.js developer: it sees, plays, inspects, builds and speeds up the pages it writes, in headless Chrome on a paused, seeded clock. What is on screen and what never appears, keys in and state out, mesh stats, procedural geometry, frame-time budgets with an optimizer, and a reminder to run and look at every page it writes.
